limitations: Instrumentation adds stack frames and elapsed overhead. This is not an unprofiled acceptance gate.
Counts cover prepared/resolved exact source types only. Inclusive times may overlap on reentrant fingerprint calls.
No argument graph, return value, exception value/text, account identifier, SQL, provider data or runtime path is stored.
Reports are written only at pytest session finish, after original test and fixture cleanup. Original exceptions and results are preserved.
Only the explicit synthetic offline retained fixture is permitted; do not use on provider/runtime datasets.
One real original entering/HALTED daily episode is inspected after original entry/binding, with a nonempty actual owned source. No fingerprint or other validation is substituted.
Extra full owner require, three original oracle fingerprints, one data-seal issue and three data checks add wall time under the unchanged original lease/deadline.

Prototype is an optimistic lower bound: initial Mapping classification, __class__ behavior, complete transitive function/code/descriptor/schema pins, authenticated root/source/episode/borrow handshake and poison/retirement are not implemented or timed.
Prototype data proof confers no source/factory authority. Unsupported actual shape falls back diagnostically; no scope or resource bounds are expanded.
Aggregate original-path counts exclude all diagnostic work. Eligible count is exact selected-source fingerprints invoked during its original borrow calls, not all resolved source validation.
No argument graph, return digest, row or provider/account value is retained in metadata; the only pure seal is released before original borrow/handoff work resumes.
The earlier30-call diagnostic remains invalid/incomplete; this independent run uses a256-call metadata counter bound, with no change to production limits.

probe.ratio_definition: (one measured full owner.require_resolved + one data issuance + drop + N times mean of3 data checks) / (N times mean of3 original fingerprints). Missing production proof costs make this optimistic; lower than1 is faster.
probe.saving_model_limitation: Compares sampled pure proof costs with actual instrumented eligible fingerprint aggregate. Missing proof costs can only add overhead; sample variation means this is an optimistic estimate, not an uninstrumented performance or guaranteed savings claim.

scope: Only target factory.execute operation on its calling thread; excludes setup, construction, assertions, factory close and fixture cleanup.
